title: Arista Networks Inc.
summary: Networking vendor specialising in high-speed Ethernet switches for hyperscale and AI clusters.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Arista is the dominant vendor for high-speed Ethernet switching in AI data centres. As GPU clusters scale from 8K to 100K+ accelerators, low-latency, non-blocking fabric becomes the binding constraint on training throughput. Arista's EOS software and its portfolio of 400G/800G switches position it as the primary beneficiary of the 'Ultra Ethernet Consortium' standard gaining share against InfiniBand. Every new hyperscaler AI cluster build is a potential Arista win. Revenue growing 20%+ annually with 35%+ operating margins and a fortress balance sheet. The key risk: NVIDIA InfiniBand holds deep integration advantages in existing Hopper/Blackwell installations, and custom merchant silicon from Broadcom could compress Arista ASPs.

Future Tech Roadmap

AI Networking & Silicon Photonics Confirmed Ongoing
📈 Arista is the reference switching platform for AI-Ethernet clusters. Switch order trends from Arista are a one-quarter leading indicator for NVIDIA GPU revenue.
GPU Compute Cluster Confirmed Ongoing
📈 Every large-scale GPU cluster requires Arista or NVIDIA (Mellanox) switching fabric. Arista is gaining share on the Ethernet side as the Ultra Ethernet Consortium standard matures.
Cloud Hyperscaler Infrastructure Confirmed Ongoing
📈 Arista's largest customers are AWS, Meta, Microsoft Azure, and Google: all accelerating AI infrastructure buildout. Revenue concentration in hyperscalers is both the thesis and the risk.
